lossless_policy: Keep the complete original JSON object at every level; overlay recognized edits. Preserve all unknown fields, arrays, object IDs and unparsed object text. Never reconstruct a document only from this bounded model.

mappings.meaning: producer metadata, not a compatibility promise
opaque ID unique within the owning patcher
serialized box class; newobj resolves runtime class from text
object expression or message body, interpreted according to maxclass; retain raw string including attributes/quotes/escapes
x,y,width,height in patching view, independent of presentation
x,y,width,height in presentation view; requires separate presentation membership
embedded nested graph; scoped IDs, recursive preservation
parameter metadata/initial values; does not universally encode current UI value
preserve order field. Loader behavior under investigation; do not claim authored order overrides layout in all modes
dependency hints, not bundled content or permission to resolve arbitrary paths

unsupported_policy: Retain unsupported objects and fields and report unsupported execution explicitly. Do not replace with guessed behavior.
